subject: PlaneGeometry
question:
Some identical rectangles are drawn on the floor. A triangle of base $10 \mathrm{~cm}$ and height $6 \mathrm{~cm}$ is drawn over them, as shown, and the region inside the rectangles and outside the triangle is shaded. What is the area of the shaded region? <image1>
Choices:
A:$10 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}$
B:$12 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}$
C:$14 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}$
D:$15 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}$
E:$21 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}$
